name: Stage 40: Dragsviken to Mellsjön
description: Official Sörmlandsleden stage 40, Dragsviken to Mellsjön.
utilities: Dragsviken is a low-service stage start with no parking at the immediate trailhead. Official and Naturkartan guidance point hikers to Långsjöns fågeltorn/Långsjöns våtmark parking about 1 km away.
Mellsjön is a real overnight/access node at the stage end, with official shelter, tenting possibility, nearby toilet, fireplace/grill context, lake access, and parking nearby.
No shops, restaurants, cafes, or public potable taps were verified directly on this short stage.

Public transport is weak. Naturkartan found no nearby stops, the nearest OSM/Sörmlandstrafiken stops are off-route, and rural access may require Sörmlandstrafiken complementary traffic or a prebooked taxi.
Nävekvarn is the practical nearby service base for linked coastal hikes, with grocery/cafe, harbour food, camping/lodging, and bus 561 toward Nyköping, but it is not on stage 40 itself.
waterSources: No verified potable tap or spring was found on stage 40.
Mellsjön is natural lake water / water of unknown quality only. Filter, boil, or otherwise treat it before drinking, and do not present it as a drinking-water tap.
notes: Sörmlandsleden does not guarantee water quality or availability; treat or filter natural sources and carry backup.
Shelters are generally free, shared, first-come, cannot be booked, and do not guarantee firewood or trash service.
In nature reserves, local camping and fire rules override allemansrätten; fires are often restricted to prepared fireplaces.

Official Sörmlandsleden lists stage 40 as 4 km, while Naturkartan exposes about 3505 m, AllTrails 3.4 km, Hiking Project 3.1 km, the local app GeoJSON measures about 3.39 km, and OSM relation 3822587 measures about 3.4 km despite a stale 4.5 km distance tag. Use 4 km as the official planning distance with a measured-line caveat.

Main-route topology runs from stage 39 at Dragsviken to stage 41 at Mellsjön. For route-builder stitching, snap to OSM node 2889662498 at 58.632850,17.004986 and OSM node 2889662243 at 58.642033,16.962128; the local route endpoints are within about 20 m of those nodes.

The official page describes a steep start up Dragsberget, then a ravine and ridge, Stora jättekasten cairn/boulder formation, Lilla Torskhult views, Stora Torskhult, and the hollow fruktbarhetseken. Blog reports add that direction matters: starting at Dragsviken puts the steep climb first, while starting at Mellsjön gives easier road/forest walking before the Dragsviken descent and can work well when linking into stage 39.
Stage 40 is easier and more inland than the exposed coastal scrambling on stage 39, but it is still somewhat hilly with hällmark/roots/rock and can be slippery in wet weather.

Mellsjön shelter is verified by Sörmlandsleden, Vindskyddskartan, OSM, Grillplatser, and later hiker reports. A 2016 geocaching note about a collapsed shelter roof appears stale because current sources list and use the shelter as active.

Official text explicitly says tenting is possible at Mellsjön and the toilet is a few minutes away. Apply normal allemansrätten judgment and any local signs; no stage-specific reserve prohibition was found in this pass.

Sörmlandsleden shelters are free, shared, first-come, cannot be booked, have no bins, and do not guarantee firewood. A blog report mentioned wood at Mellsjön during one visit, but current wood supply should not be assumed. Pack out waste and verify shelter condition before depending on it overnight.

Use only prepared fireplaces/grill places, especially the Mellsjön shelter/grill area, bring your own fuel if needed, and check current Nyköping/Sörmlandskusten fire-ban status because stricter bans can also prohibit fixed grill places. Do not make fires on rock slabs or hällmark.
The stage can work as a short standalone hike or as part of a roughly 10 km official loop by parking at Mellsjön, using early stage 41 toward Östra Koviken, and returning via stage 39/40 context.

No protected-area or Natura 2000 polygon was found intersecting the Dragsviken-Långsjön-Mellsjön corridor during the 2026-04-27 public-source check, but local signs and general allemansrätten/fire rules still apply. Keep dogs leashed or under very close control around lake-shore wildlife, rural properties, and during wildlife season.

Dragsviken is a weak emergency/access point because there is no parking at the trailhead and public transport is poor. Mellsjön and Långsjöns fågeltorn parking are better practical access/evacuation points.
The official page showed no current fault reports during the 2026-04-27 research pass. Adjacent stage 41 still has an older 2023 reroute caveat if continuing west from Mellsjön.

facilities.name: Dragsviken / stage 40 start
facilities.description: OSM topology endpoint shared with stage 39; official stage start marker is nearby at 58.632750,17.005017. Low-service start with no parking at the immediate trailhead.

facilities.name: Dragsviken no-parking warning
facilities.description: Access warning: official stage 40 says there is no parking at the stage start; use Långsjöns fågeltorn/Långsjöns våtmark about 1 km away.

facilities.name: Långsjöns fågeltorn / våtmark parking
facilities.description: Access parking about 1 km from Dragsviken. Naturkartan notes parking for about five cars near the restored wetland/bird tower; arrive early on busy birding weekends.

facilities.name: Långsjöns fågeltorn / restored wetland
facilities.description: Bird tower and restored wetland access point completed in 2018. Local birding sources describe roughly 30 hectares of restored wetland and accessible parking/path context.

facilities.name: Dragsberget steep climb
facilities.description: Approximate terrain-warning marker for the steep initial climb from Dragsviken into ravine/ridge terrain.

facilities.name: Stora jättekasten cairn
facilities.description: Approximate route-derived heritage/viewpoint marker for the large cairn and raised boundary stone about 1 km into the stage.

facilities.name: Lilla Torskhult view
facilities.description: Approximate view/landmark context toward Lilla Torskhult and its old cottage; route-derived pin needs field confirmation.

facilities.name: Stora Torskhult fruktbarhetsek
facilities.description: Approximate marker for the hollow giant oak mentioned by official route text; route-derived pin needs field confirmation.

facilities.name: Mellsjön shelter
facilities.description: Official shelter/rest point at Mellsjön, confirmed by Sörmlandsleden, OSM, Vindskyddskartan, Grillplatser, and later hiker reports. Free, shared, first-come, and not reservable; old 2016 roof-damage reports appear stale but verify condition before relying on it overnight.

facilities.name: Mellsjön tenting area
facilities.description: Official stage text says tenting is possible at/near the Mellsjön shelter; follow local signs and leave no trace.

facilities.name: Mellsjön fireplace / grill
facilities.description: Prepared grill/fireplace cluster by the shelter according to Grillplatser/Vindskyddskartan context. Bring fuel and check fire-ban status.

facilities.name: Mellsjön dry toilet
facilities.description: OSM pit-latrine/dry-toilet marker near the shelter; official text says the toilet is a few minutes away.

facilities.name: Mellsjön natural water / unknown quality
facilities.description: Lake/shore water only. Vindskyddskartan lists water of unknown quality; filter/boil/treat and do not treat as potable tap water.

facilities.name: Mellsjön / stage 41 start
facilities.description: OSM topology endpoint shared with stage 41; official stage 41 start/access marker is nearby at 58.642017,16.962117.

facilities.name: Mellsjön parking/access
facilities.description: Approximate parking/access near the stage end per official stage context; check exact local parking signs and avoid blocking rural/forestry access.

facilities.name: Ytterbovägen bus stop
facilities.description: Off-route bus stop about 1.8 km from Mellsjön and about 4.5 km from Dragsviken; verify timetable.

facilities.name: Överbo bus stop
facilities.description: Off-route bus stop about 2.0 km from Mellsjön and about 4.7 km from Dragsviken; verify timetable.

facilities.name: Stora Utterviksvägen bus stop
facilities.description: Off-route bus stop about 2.4 km from Mellsjön and about 4.9 km from Dragsviken; verify timetable.

facilities.name: Nävekvarn service base
facilities.description: Nearby coastal service base for linked hikes, with grocery/cafe, harbour food, camping/lodging and bus 561 toward Nyköping. Useful before/after stages 37-41 but not on stage 40 itself.

facilities.name: Nyköping/Oxelösund taxi access
facilities.description: Rural trailhead fallback: prebook local taxi or check Sörmlandstrafiken complementary traffic before relying on pickup/drop-off at Dragsviken or Mellsjön.

facilities.name: Nyköping C train access
facilities.description: Nearest practical train anchor, roughly 13-15 km from this stage by straight line; far/off-route context only.
